title: Higher-Dimensional Schur Trigonometry and the 1152 Invariant Integer Floor
description: We prove that taring out the symmetric Sp(8) divisor classes of norms sixteen and four hundred thirty-two via the matrix Schur complement isolates an exact integer floor of eleven hundred fifty-two at an exact ninety-degree right angle. We formalize this constructive identity in Lean 4 with zero sorry, confirming that the algebraic cycle cannot collapse to zero or decay into background divisor noise. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
